units.zh: 蕭陶蘇斡耶律阿息保蕭乙薛蕭胡篤
units.en: Xiao Taosuwo, Yelu Axibao, Xiao Yixue, and Xiao Hudu
units.literal: Xiao Taosuwo, Yelu Axibao, Xiao Yixue, Xiao Hudu

units.zh: 蕭陶蘇斡，字乙辛隱，突呂不部人。
units.en: Xiao Taosuwo, whose courtesy name was Yixin'yin, came from the Tielubu tribe.
units.literal: Xiao Taosuwo, courtesy name Yixin'yin, was a man of the Tielubu tribe.

units.zh: 四世祖因吉，發長五尺，時呼為「長發因吉」。
units.en: A fourth-generation forebear, Yinji, wore his hair five feet long and was known in his day as "Long-haired Yinji."
units.literal: His fourth-generation ancestor Yinji had hair five chi long and was called at the time "Long-haired Yinji."

units.zh: 祖裏拔，奧隗部節度使。
units.en: His grandfather Liba served as military commissioner for the Aowei tribe.
units.literal: His grandfather Liba was Military Commissioner of the Aowei tribe.

units.zh: 陶蘇斡謹願，不妄交。
units.en: Taosuwo was cautious by nature and would not cultivate casual acquaintances.
units.literal: Taosuwo was prudent and cautious and did not associate carelessly.

units.zh: 伯父留哥坐事免官，聞重元亂，挈家赴行在。
units.en: His uncle Liuge had been stripped of his post for an offense; when word came of Chongyuan's revolt, he took his household to the emperor's camp.
units.literal: His uncle Liuge was dismissed from office on account of an offense; hearing of Chongyuan's rebellion, he took his family to join the imperial procession.

units.zh: 時陶蘇斡雖幼，已如成人，補筆硯小底。
units.en: Though still a boy, Taosuwo already comported himself like a grown man and was assigned as a junior clerk in charge of writing materials.
units.literal: At the time, although Taosuwo was still young, he already behaved like an adult and was appointed a petty clerk for brush and inkstone.

units.zh: 累遷祗候郎君，轉樞密院侍御。
units.en: He rose through successive posts to Attendant Gentleman and then became a palace attendant in the Privy Council.
units.literal: He was promoted repeatedly to Attendant Gentleman and then transferred to Palace Attendant in the Privy Council.

units.zh: 咸雍五年，遷崇德宮使。
units.en: In the fifth year of the Xianyong era, he was appointed director of the Chongde Palace.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Xianyong, he was transferred to Director of the Chongde Palace.

units.zh: 會有訴北南院聽訟不直者，事下，陶蘇斡悉改正之，為耶律阿思所忌。
units.en: When a petitioner alleged that the North and South Councils had heard cases unfairly, the matter came before Taosuwo, who corrected every ruling—earning the enmity of Yelu Asi.
units.literal: When someone complained that the North and South Councils had judged cases unjustly, the matter was referred down and Taosuwo corrected them all, for which he was resented by Yelu Asi.

units.zh: 帝欲召用，輒為所沮。
units.en: The emperor wished to bring him into higher office, but each time Yelu Asi blocked it.
units.literal: The emperor wished to summon and employ him, but Asi repeatedly obstructed it.

units.zh: 八年，歷漠北滑水馬群太保，數年不調，嘗曰：「用才未盡，不若閑。」
units.en: In the eighth year he was posted as grand guardian of the northern Huashui horse herds beyond the desert; for years he received no promotion, and remarked, "When one's abilities go unused, idleness is preferable."
units.literal: In the eighth year, he served as Northern Desert Huashui Horse Herd Grand Guardian; for several years he received no transfer and once said, "When talent is not fully used, it is better to be idle."

units.zh: 乾統中，遷漠南馬群太保，以大風傷草，馬多死，鞭之三百，免官。
units.en: Under the Qiantong reign he was made grand guardian of the southern horse herds; when a violent wind ruined the pasture and many horses died, he was given three hundred lashes and removed from office.
units.literal: During Qiantong he was transferred to Southern Desert Horse Herd Grand Guardian; a great wind damaged the grass and many horses died; he was flogged three hundred strokes and dismissed from office.

units.zh: 九年，徙天齊殿宿衛。
units.en: In the ninth year he was reassigned as a palace guard of the Tianqi Hall.
units.literal: In the ninth year, he was moved to palace guard duty at the Tianqi Hall.

units.zh: 明年，谷價翔踴，宿衛士多不給，陶蘇斡出私廩赒之，召同知南院樞密使事。
units.en: The following year grain prices shot up, and many guards could not make ends meet; Taosuwo opened his private stores to feed them and was thereupon appointed associate director of the Southern Council Privy Council.
units.literal: The next year grain prices soared; many palace guards could not support themselves, and Taosuwo drew on his private granary to relieve them; he was summoned as Associate Director of Southern Council Privy Council affairs.

units.zh: 天慶四年，為漢人行宮副部署。
units.en: In the fourth year of Tianqing he was named deputy commissioner of the bureau for the Chinese palace.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqing, he became Deputy Commissioner of the Chinese Palace Bureau.

units.zh: 時金兵初起，攻陷寧江州。
units.en: The Jin armies had just risen in force and taken Ningjiang Prefecture.
units.literal: At the time the Jin troops had just risen and captured Ningjiang Prefecture.

units.zh: 天祚召群臣議，陶蘇斡曰：「女直國雖小，其人勇而善射。
units.en: Emperor Tianzuo called his ministers into council; Taosuwo said, "Small though the Jurchen realm may be, its warriors are fierce and expert archers.
units.literal: Tianzuo summoned the ministers for deliberation; Taosuwo said, "Although the Jurchen state is small, its people are brave and skilled at archery.

units.zh: 自執我叛人蕭海裏，勢益張。
units.en: Ever since they took our defector Xiao Hai'li into their ranks, their strength has only swelled.
units.literal: Since they seized our rebel Xiao Hai'li, their power has grown ever greater.

units.zh: 我兵久不練，若遇強敵，稍有不利，諸部離心，不可制矣。
units.en: Our forces have long neglected drill; should we meet a formidable foe and suffer the slightest reverse, the tribes will lose heart and slip beyond control.
units.literal: Our troops have long gone untrained; if we meet a strong enemy and suffer even a slight setback, the tribes will lose heart and cannot be controlled.

units.zh: 為今之計，莫若大發諸道兵，以威壓之，庶可服也。」
units.en: The sound course now is to muster armies from every commandery at once and overawe them by sheer weight—only then might they yield."
units.literal: For the present plan, nothing is better than raising troops from all circuits in great force to overawe them; then perhaps they may submit."

units.zh: 北院樞密使蕭得裏底曰：「如陶蘇斡之謀，徒示弱耳。
units.en: Xiao Delidi, privy commissioner of the Northern Council, replied, "A scheme like Taosuwo's would only broadcast our weakness.
units.literal: Northern Council Privy Commissioner Xiao Delidi said, "A plan like Taosuwo's would only show weakness.

units.zh: 但發滑水以北兵，足以拒之。」
units.en: Troops raised north of the Huashui alone will suffice to hold them off."
units.literal: It is enough to deploy troops from north of the Huashui River to repel them."

units.zh: 遂不用其計。
units.en: His counsel was rejected.
units.literal: They therefore did not adopt his plan.

units.zh: 數月間，邊兵屢北，人益不安。
units.en: Within months the border armies were beaten again and again, and popular alarm deepened.
units.literal: Within several months the frontier troops were repeatedly defeated and the people grew ever more uneasy.

units.zh: 饒州渤海結構頭下城以叛，有步騎三萬餘，招之不下。
units.en: The Bohai people of Raozhou joined forces with a touxia appanage city in rebellion, fielding more than thirty thousand infantry and cavalry; summonses failed to bring them to submit.
units.literal: The Bohai of Raozhou conspired with a touxia city and rebelled; they had more than thirty thousand foot and horse, and summonses did not bring them to submit.

units.zh: 陶蘇斡帥兵往討，擒其渠魁，斬首數千級，得所掠物，悉還其主。
units.en: Taosuwo marched against them, seized their leaders, decapitated several thousand rebels, recovered all stolen property, and returned every item to its rightful owner.
units.literal: Taosuwo led troops to campaign against them, captured their ringleaders, beheaded several thousand, recovered the plundered goods, and returned them all to their owners.

units.zh: 及耶律章奴叛，陶蘇斡與留守耶律大悲奴為守禦。
units.en: When Yelu Zhangnu rose in revolt, Taosuwo and the capital's garrison commander Yelu Dabeinu organized the city's defense.
units.literal: When Yelu Zhangnu rebelled, Taosuwo and the garrison commander Yelu Dabeinu held the defenses.

units.zh: 章奴既平，陶蘇斡請曰：「今邊兵懈弛，若清暑嶺西，則漢人嘯聚，民心益搖。
units.en: Once Zhangnu was crushed, Taosuwo pleaded, "The border forces are slack; if Your Majesty crosses west of Qinghu Ridge, Han subjects will flock together in defiance and the people's hearts will quail the more.
units.literal: After Zhangnu was suppressed, Taosuwo petitioned, "Now the frontier troops are slack; if [the emperor] crosses west of the Qinghu Ridge, the Chinese will rally and clamor, and popular morale will shake all the more.

units.zh: 臣愚以為宜罷此行。」
units.en: This humble servant believes the expedition ought to be called off."
units.literal: Your servant, in his folly, thinks this journey should be abandoned."

units.zh: 不納，乃命陶蘇斡控扼東路，招集散卒。
units.en: The counsel went unheeded; instead Taosuwo was ordered to hold the eastern front and rally scattered troops.
units.literal: [The petition] was not accepted; Taosuwo was then ordered to control the eastern route and gather scattered soldiers.

units.zh: 後以太子太傅致仕，卒。
units.en: He later retired as Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died.
units.literal: Later he retired with the title Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and died.

units.zh: 耶律阿息保，字特裏典，五院部人。
units.en: Yelu Axibao, whose courtesy name was Telidian, came from the Five-Yuan tribe.
units.literal: Yelu Axibao, courtesy name Telidian, was a man of the Five-Yuan tribe.

units.zh: 祖胡劣，太祖時徙居西北部，世為招討司吏。
units.en: His grandfather Hulu, in the reign of Taizu, resettled in the northwest, and for generations the family served as clerks in the pacification commission.
units.literal: His grandfather Hulu, in Taizu's time, moved to the northwest and for generations served as clerks in the pacification commission.

units.zh: 阿息保慷慨有大志，年十六，以才幹補內史。
units.en: Axibao was openhanded and ambitious; at sixteen he was appointed Inner Scribe on the strength of his abilities.
units.literal: Axibao was magnanimous and ambitious; at sixteen he entered service as Inner Scribe on account of his talent.

units.zh: 天慶初，轉樞密院侍御。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianqing era he was transferred to palace attendant in the Privy Council.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianqing he was transferred to Privy Council palace attendant.

units.zh: 金人起兵，城境上，遣阿息保問之，金人曰：「若歸阿疏，敢不聽命。」
units.en: When the Jin took up arms and fortified the frontier, Axibao was dispatched to inquire; the Jin replied, "If you hand back Ashu, we would not dare refuse your command."
units.literal: When the Jin rose in arms and built fortifications on the border, Axibao was sent to inquire; the Jin said, "If [you] return Ashu, we dare not disobey orders."

units.zh: 阿息保具以聞。
units.en: Axibao reported the full exchange to the throne.
units.literal: Axibao reported all of it in full.

units.zh: 金兵陷寧江州，邊兵屢敗，遣阿息保與耶律章奴等賫書而東，冀以脅降。
units.en: After the Jin captured Ningjiang and the border armies suffered defeat after defeat, Axibao was sent east with Yelu Zhangnu and others bearing letters, hoping to intimidate the enemy into submission.
units.literal: When Jin troops took Ningjiang and frontier forces were repeatedly defeated, Axibao was sent with Yelu Zhangnu and others bearing documents eastward, hoping to coerce submission.

units.zh: 阿息保曰：「臣前使，依詔開諭，略無所屈。
units.en: Axibao said, "On my last embassy I delivered the imperial message as instructed and would not yield an inch.
units.literal: Axibao said, "On my previous mission I expounded the edict and was in no way bent.

units.zh: 將還，謂臣曰：『若所請不遂，無相見。』
units.en: As I was leaving they told me, 'If our demands are not met, we shall not meet again.'
units.literal: When I was about to return they told me, 'If our request is not granted, we shall not meet again.'

units.zh: 今臣請獨往。」
units.en: I beg now to go alone."
units.literal: Now I beg to go alone."

units.zh: 不聽。
units.en: The court would not hear of it.
units.literal: [His request] was not granted.

units.zh: 將行，別蕭得裏底曰：「不肖適異國，必無生還，願公善輔國家。」
units.en: Before he set out he bade farewell to Xiao Delidi, saying, "Your unworthy servant is bound for a foreign land and will surely not return alive; may you govern the realm well in my stead."
units.literal: Before departing he took leave of Xiao Delidi, saying, "Your unworthy servant goes to a foreign land and will certainly not return alive; may you well assist the state."

units.zh: 既至，阿息保見執。
units.en: On arrival he was taken prisoner.
units.literal: When he arrived, Axibao was seized.

units.zh: 久乃遁歸。
units.en: Only after a long captivity did he escape and make his way home.
units.literal: After a long time he escaped and returned.

units.zh: 及天祚敗績，遷都巡捕使。
units.en: After Tianzuo's crushing defeat, he was appointed metropolitan patrol commissioner.
units.literal: When Tianzuo suffered a crushing defeat, [Axibao] was made Metropolitan Patrol Commissioner.

units.zh: 六年，從阿疏討耶律章奴，加領軍衛大將軍。
units.en: In the sixth year he followed Ashu against Yelu Zhangnu and was additionally made general-in-chief of the Army Guard.
units.literal: In the sixth year he followed Ashu to campaign against Yelu Zhangnu and was additionally appointed General-in-Chief of the Army Guard.

units.zh: 阿疏將兵而東，阿息保送至軍，乃還。
units.en: Ashu marched east with his army; Axibao escorted him to the encampment and then turned back.
units.literal: Ashu led his army east; Axibao escorted him to the camp and then returned.

units.zh: 天祚怒其專，鞭之三百。
units.en: Tianzuo, angered that he had acted on his own authority, had him flogged three hundred strokes.
units.literal: Tianzuo was angry at his acting on his own authority and had him flogged three hundred strokes.

units.zh: 尋為奚六部禿裏太尉。
units.en: He was soon appointed grand guardian tuli of the Six Xi tribes.
units.literal: Soon after he was made Grand Guardian Tuli of the Six Xi Tribes.

units.zh: 後阿疏反，阿息保以偏師進擊，臨陣墜馬，被擒。
units.en: When Ashu later rebelled, Axibao led a detached column against him, was thrown from his horse in battle, and taken captive.
units.literal: Later when Ashu rebelled, Axibao advanced with a detached force, fell from his horse in battle, and was captured.

units.zh: 因阿疏有舊得免。
units.en: Thanks to his old friendship with Ashu he was spared.
units.literal: Because of his old ties with Ashu he was spared.

units.zh: 時阿疏頗好殺，阿息保謂曰：「欲舉大事，何以殺為！」
units.en: Ashu was then inclined to slaughter; Axibao told him, "If you mean to accomplish a great undertaking, why make killing your way!"
units.literal: At the time Ashu was rather fond of killing; Axibao said to him, "If you wish to accomplish a great undertaking, why make killing your way!"

units.zh: 由是全活者眾。
units.en: Because of this counsel a great many lives were spared.
units.literal: Because of this many were preserved alive in full.

units.zh: 會阿疏敗，乃還。
units.en: When Ashu was defeated, he made his way back.
units.literal: When Ashu was defeated, [Axibao] then returned.

units.zh: 以戰失利，囚中京數歲。
units.en: For the defeat he was imprisoned at Zhongjing for several years.
units.literal: For the battle's failure he was imprisoned at Zhongjing for several years.

units.zh: 保大二年，金兵至中京，始出獄。
units.en: In the second year of Baoda, when Jin forces reached Zhongjing, he was at last released from prison.
units.literal: In the second year of Baoda, when Jin troops reached Zhongjing, he was first released from prison.

units.zh: 尋為敵烈皮室詳穩。
units.en: He was soon made chief of the Dilie pishi guard.
units.literal: Soon after he was made Chief of the Dilie Pishi guard.

units.zh: 是時，魏王淳僭號，屢遣人以書來招。
units.en: At this time Prince Chun of Wei had usurped a royal title and repeatedly sent envoys with letters to win him over.
units.literal: At this time Prince Chun of Wei had assumed a royal title unlawfully and repeatedly sent men with letters to recruit him.

units.zh: 阿息保封書以獻，因諫曰：「東兵甚銳，未可輕敵。」
units.en: Axibao sealed the letter and presented it to the throne, admonishing, "The eastern armies are very sharp; they must not be underestimated."
units.literal: Axibao sealed the letter and presented it, admonishing, "The eastern troops are very sharp; they must not be treated lightly."

units.zh: 及石輦鐸之敗，天祚奔竄，召阿息保，不時至，疑有貳心，並怒為淳所招，殺之。
units.en: After Shinian Duo's defeat, as Tianzuo fled in disarray he summoned Axibao, who failed to arrive promptly; suspecting disloyalty and enraged that Chun had tried to recruit him, Tianzuo had him executed.
units.literal: When Shinian Duo was defeated, Tianzuo fled in disarray; he summoned Axibao, who did not arrive in time; suspecting divided loyalty and also angered that Chun had tried to recruit him, [Tianzuo] had him killed.

units.zh: 初，阿息保知國將亡，前後諫甚切。
units.en: From the first, Axibao had seen that the state was doomed and remonstrated again and again with desperate urgency.
units.literal: Earlier, Axibao knew the state was about to perish and remonstrated repeatedly with great urgency.

units.zh: 及死以非罪，人尤惜之。
units.en: When he was put to death without just cause, the people mourned him all the more.
units.literal: When he died without crime, people regretted it all the more.

units.zh: 蕭乙薛，字特免，國舅少父房子後。
units.en: Xiao Yixue, whose courtesy name was Temian, was a descendant of the junior imperial uncle's younger son.
units.literal: Xiao Yixue, courtesy name Temian, was descended from the Junior Uncle's younger son.

units.zh: 性謹願。
units.en: He was cautious and steady by nature.
units.literal: By nature he was prudent and cautious.

units.zh: 壽隆間，累任劇官。
units.en: During the Shoulong era he held one weighty post after another.
units.literal: During Shoulong he repeatedly held weighty offices.

units.zh: 天慶初，知國舅詳穩事，遷殿前副點檢。
units.en: At the opening of Tianqing he oversaw imperial-uncle guard affairs and was promoted to deputy director of palace inspection.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianqing he oversaw Imperial Uncle guard affairs and was promoted Deputy Director of Palace Inspection.

units.zh: 金兵起，為行軍副都統。
units.en: When the Jin armies rose, he was made deputy commanding general on campaign.
units.literal: When the Jin armies rose, he became Deputy Commanding General on Campaign.

units.zh: 以戰失利，罷職。
units.en: After a defeat in battle he was removed from office.
units.literal: For defeat in battle he was dismissed.

units.zh: 六年，出為武定軍節度使，遷西京留守。
units.en: In the sixth year he was posted as military commissioner of the Wuding army and transferred to garrison commissioner of the Western Capital.
units.literal: In the sixth year he went out as Military Commissioner of Wuding Army and was transferred to Western Capital Garrison Commissioner.

units.zh: 明年，討劇賊董厖兒，戰易水西，大破之。
units.en: The following year he campaigned against the fierce bandit Dong Mang'er, fought west of the Yishui, and routed him utterly.
units.literal: The next year he campaigned against the fierce bandit Dong Mang'er, fought west of the Yishui, and routed him utterly.

units.zh: 以功為北府宰相，加左僕射，兼東北路都統。
units.en: For his merit he was made chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with the additional title of left vice director and concurrent commander of the Northeast Route army.
units.literal: For his merit he was made Chancellor of the Northern Prefecture, with additional title Left Vice Director, and concurrent Commander of the Eastern Route Army.

units.zh: 十年，金兵陷上京，詔兼上京留守、東北路統軍使。
units.en: In the tenth year, when Jin forces captured Shangjing, he was ordered to serve concurrently as Shangjing garrison commissioner and commander of the Eastern Route army.
units.literal: In the tenth year, when Jin troops took Shangjing, he was ordered to serve concurrently as Shangjing Garrison Commissioner and Eastern Route Army Commander.

units.zh: 為政寬猛得宜，民之窮困者，輒加振恤，眾咸愛之。
units.en: In office he balanced lenience and severity; whenever the people fell into want he gave relief, and all held him in affection.
units.literal: In governing he balanced lenience and severity; whenever the people were destitute he gave relief, and all loved him.

units.zh: 保大二年，金兵大至，乙薛軍潰，左遷西南面招討使。
units.en: In the second year of Baoda, when Jin armies came in overwhelming force, Yixue's army collapsed and he was demoted to southwest pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In Baoda year two, when Jin armies came in force, Yixue's army collapsed and he was demoted to Southwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 以部民流散，不赴。
units.en: Because his tribal subjects had scattered, he did not take up the post.
units.literal: Because his tribal subjects had scattered, he did not go.

units.zh: 及天祚播遷，給侍從不闕，拜殿前都點檢。
units.en: When Tianzuo wandered in exile, he supplied attendants without fail and was appointed director of palace inspection.
units.literal: When Tianzuo wandered in exile, [Yixue] supplied attendants without fail and was appointed Director of Palace Inspection.

units.zh: 凡金兵所過，諸營敗卒復聚上京，遣乙薛為上京留守以安撫之。
units.en: Wherever Jin armies passed, defeated soldiers from the camps regathered at Shangjing; Yixue was sent as Shangjing commissioner to pacify them.
units.literal: Wherever Jin troops passed, defeated soldiers from the camps regathered at Shangjing; Yixue was sent as Shangjing commissioner to pacify them.

units.zh: 明年，盧彥倫以城叛，乙薛被執數月，以居官無過，得釋。
units.en: The following year Lu Yanlun rebelled with the city; Yixue was held for several months and released because he had committed no fault in office.
units.literal: The next year Lu Yanlun rebelled with the city; Yixue was held several months and released because he had committed no fault in office.

units.zh: 後為耶律大石所殺。
units.en: He was later killed by Yelu Dashi.
units.literal: Later he was killed by Yelu Dashi.

units.zh: 蕭胡篤，字合術隱。
units.en: Xiao Hudu, whose courtesy name was Heshu'yin.
units.literal: Xiao Hudu, courtesy name Heshu'yin.

units.zh: 其先撒葛只，太祖時願隸宮分，遂為太和宮分人。
units.en: His forebear Sagezhi, in the reign of Taizu, asked to be enrolled in palace household service and thus became a man of the Taihe palace household.
units.literal: His forebear Sagezhi, in Taizu's time, wished to be enrolled in palace household service and thus became a man of the Taihe palace household.

units.zh: 曾祖敵魯，明醫。
units.en: His great-grandfather Dilu was a renowned physician.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Dilu was a renowned physician.

units.zh: 人有疾，觀其形色即知病所在。
units.en: When a patient fell ill, he could tell at a glance from complexion and bearing where the affliction lay.
units.literal: When someone fell ill, by observing complexion and form he knew at once where the disease lay.

units.zh: 統和中，宰相韓德讓貴寵，敵魯希旨，言德讓宜賜國姓，籍橫帳，由是世預太醫選。
units.en: During the Tonghe era, Chancellor Han Derang enjoyed the highest favor; Dilu read the imperial mood and argued that Derang should be granted the imperial surname and enrolled in the horizontal registers, whereupon the family for generations entered the imperial physician rolls.
units.literal: In Tonghe, Chancellor Han Derang enjoyed lofty favor; Dilu followed the imperial intent, saying Derang should be granted the imperial surname and enrolled in the horizontal registers, whereupon [the family] for generations entered imperial physician selection.

units.zh: 子孫因之入官者眾。
units.en: Many of his descendants entered office by this connection.
units.literal: Many descendants entered office through this connection.

units.zh: 胡篤為人便佞，與物無忤。
units.en: Hudu was smooth and ingratiating by nature and gave offense to no one.
units.literal: Hudu was facile and ingratiating by nature and gave offense to none.

units.zh: 清寧初，補近侍。
units.en: At the opening of Qingning he was appointed to palace attendance.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qingning he was appointed to palace attendance.

units.zh: 大安元年，為彰湣宮太師。
units.en: In the first year of Da'an he was made grand master of the Zhangmin Palace.
units.literal: In the first year of Da'an he was made Grand Master of the Zhangmin Palace.

units.zh: 壽隆二年，轉永興宮太師。
units.en: In the second year of Shoulong he was transferred to grand master of the Yongxing Palace.
units.literal: In Shoulong year two he was transferred to Grand Master of the Yongxing Palace.

units.zh: 天慶初，累遷至殿前副點檢。
units.en: At the opening of Tianqing he rose step by step to deputy director of palace inspection.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianqing he was promoted step by step to Deputy Director of Palace Inspection.

units.zh: 五年，從天祚東征，為先鋒都統，臨事猶豫，凡隊伍皆以圍場名號之。
units.en: In the fifth year he followed Tianzuo on the eastern campaign as vanguard commanding general; in action he was irresolute, and every unit was named after a hunting park.
units.literal: In year five he followed Tianzuo on the eastern campaign as vanguard commanding general; in action he was irresolute; all units were named after hunting parks.

units.zh: 進至剌離水，與金兵戰，敗，大軍亦卻。
units.en: Advancing to the Chali River, he fought the Jin and was defeated, and the main army fell back as well.
units.literal: Advancing to the Chali River, he fought the Jin and was defeated; the main army also retreated.

units.zh: 及討耶律章奴，以籍私奴為軍，遷知北院樞密使事，卒。
units.en: When campaigning against Yelu Zhangnu he mustered his private bondsmen as an army; he was transferred to oversight of Northern Council privy council affairs and died.
units.literal: When campaigning against Yelu Zhangnu he mustered private bondsmen as troops; he was transferred to oversight of Northern Council Privy Council affairs and died.

units.zh: 胡篤長於騎射，見天祚好遊畋，每言從禽之樂，以逢其意。
units.en: Hudu excelled at mounted archery; seeing Tianzuo's love of the hunt, he always spoke of the pleasures of the chase to please him.
units.literal: Hudu excelled at mounted archery; seeing Tianzuo's fondness for hunting, he always spoke of the pleasures of the chase to please him.

units.zh: 天祚悅而從之。
units.en: Tianzuo was delighted and followed his lead.
units.literal: Tianzuo was pleased and followed his lead.

units.zh: 國政隳廢，自此始雲。
units.en: The ruin of state administration, it is said, began from this.
units.literal: The ruin of state administration began from this, it is said.

units.zh: 論曰：甚矣，承平日久，上下狃於故常之可畏也！
units.en: The commentary says: How grave a matter! When peace endures too long, those above and below grow attached to the familiar—and that is what should terrify us!
units.literal: Commentary says: How extreme! When peace lasts long, superior and inferior cling to old ways—that is something to fear!

units.zh: 天慶之間，女直方熾，惟陶蘇斡明於料敵，善於忠諫，惜乎天祚痼蔽，不見信用。
units.en: During the Tianqing years the Jurchen were in full ascent; only Taosuwo was clear-eyed in judging the foe and steadfast in loyal remonstrance—yet Tianzuo was set in blindness and would not heed him.
units.literal: During Tianqing the Jurchen were flourishing; only Taosuwo was clear in assessing the enemy and skilled in loyal remonstrance—alas, Tianzuo was set in blindness and did not employ him.

units.zh: 阿息保不死阿疏之難，乙薛甘忍盧彥倫之執，大節已失矣，他有所長，亦奚足取。
units.en: Axibao did not perish in Ashu's disaster, and Yixue submitted to Lu Yanlun's capture—their paramount integrity was already gone; whatever other talents they possessed, what is there to esteem?
units.literal: Axibao did not die in Ashu's peril; Yixue willingly endured Lu Yanlun's seizure; their great integrity was already lost; even if they had other strengths, what is there worth taking?

units.zh: 胡篤以遊畋逢迎天祚而隳國政，可勝罪哉！
units.en: Hudu ruined the governance of the realm by hunting and hawking to win Tianzuo's favor—what punishment would not be too light!
units.literal: Hudu, by hunting and hawking to court Tianzuo's favor, ruined state administration—can his guilt be fully told!

units.zh: 庚戌，皇孫延禧生。
units.en: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.
units.literal: On gengxu day the imperial grandson Yanxi was born.

units.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。
units.en: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
units.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

units.zh: 辛丑，耶律沙遣人上俘獲，以權知南京留守事韓德讓、權南京馬步軍都指揮使耶律學古、知三司事劉弘皆能安人心，捍城池，並賜詔褒獎。
units.en: On xinchou day Yelü Sha sent up prisoners; edicts commended Han Derang, acting Nanjing regent, Yelü Xuegu, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander, and Liu Hong, director of the Three Departments, for steadying morale and holding the city.
units.literal: On xinchou day, Yelü Sha sent men presenting captives; because acting Nanjing regent Han Derang, acting Nanjing cavalry-and-infantry commander Yelü Xuegu, and Director of the Three Departments Liu Hong had all been able to steady hearts and defend the walls, edicts of praise and reward were granted to each.

units.zh: 十二月，以遼興軍節度使韓德讓為南院樞密使。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was appointed Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Liaoxing Army Military Commissioner Han Derang was made Southern Court Commissioner of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 甲申，詔北院樞密使魏王耶律乙辛同母兄大奴、同母弟阿思世預北、南院樞密之選，其異母諸弟世預夷離堇之選。
units.en: On jiashen day an edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.
units.literal: On jiashen day, edict ordered Northern Court privy commissioner Prince of Wei Yelü Yixin's elder brother by the same mother Danu and younger brother by the same mother Asi to be hereditary in selection for Northern and Southern Court privy commissioner; his younger brothers by different mothers were hereditary in selection for yilibi.

units.zh: 十二月戊辰，漢人行宮都部署耶律仲禧封韓國公，樞密副使、參知政事趙徽出為武定軍節度使，樞密副使柴德滋參知政事，漢人行宮副部署耶律大悲奴升都部署，同知南院樞密使事蕭韓家奴知左夷離畢事。
units.en: On wuchen day of the twelfth month Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi was made Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu was made administrator of Left yilibi affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on wuchen day Han mobile palace deployment director Yelü Zhongxi was enfeoffed Duke of Han; associate privy commissioner and Associate Administrator of Affairs Zhao Hui was dismissed as military commissioner of Wuding Army; associate privy commissioner Chai Dezi Associate Administrator of Affairs; Han mobile palace deputy deployment director Yelü Dabeinu was promoted deployment director; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hanjianu administrator of Left yilibi affairs.

units.zh: 以惕隱大悲奴為始平軍節度使，參知政事柴德滋武定軍節度使。
units.en: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.
units.literal: Tiyin Dabeinu was made military commissioner of Shiping Army; Associate Administrator of Affairs Chai Dezi military commissioner of Wuding Army.

units.zh: 穆宗攻阿疏日，辰巳間，忽暴雨昏曀，雷電環阿疏所居，是夕有巨火聲如雷，墜阿疏城中，遂攻下之。
units.en: When Muzong besieged Ashuri, between the chen and si hours a violent rainstorm darkened the sky; lightning ringed Ashuri's dwelling; that night a great fire, loud as thunder, fell into Ashuri's town—and the place was taken.
units.literal: When Muzong besieged Ashuri, between the chen and si hours a violent rainstorm darkened the sky; lightning ringed Ashuri's dwelling; that night a great fire, thunder-loud, fell into Ashuri's town—and the place was taken.

units.zh: 及天祚親征女直，蕭胡篤為先鋒都統，章奴為都監。
units.en: When Tianzuo led a personal campaign against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu was made vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu army inspector.
units.literal: When Tianzuo personally campaigned against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu served as vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu as army inspector.

units.zh: 戊寅，契丹阿保機遣使貢良馬。
units.en: On wuyin Abaoji sent fine horses as tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin the Khitan Abaoji sent envoys presenting fine horses.

units.zh: 丙寅，以同知南京留守事蕭得裏底知北院樞密使事。
units.en: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.
units.literal: On bingyin day associate regent of Nanjing Xiao Delidi was made Northern Court privy commissioner.

units.zh: 一二：辛丑，以西北路招討使耶律斡里朵為行軍都統，一三：副點檢蕭乙薛、同知南院樞密使事耶律章奴副之。
units.en: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.
units.literal: — [12]: On xinchou day Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Woliduo was made field army commander-in-chief; — [13]: deputy inspector Xiao Yixue and associate Southern Court privy commissioner Yelü Zhangnu were deputies.

units.zh: 庚辰，宜、錦、乾、顯、成、川、豪、懿等州相繼皆降，上京盧彥倫叛，殺契丹人。
units.en: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.
units.literal: On gengchen day Yi, Jin, Qian, Xian, Cheng, Chuan, Hao, Yi, and other prefectures in succession all surrendered; Supreme Capital Lu Yanlun rebelled and killed Khitan people.

units.zh: 甲子，初，張覺為遼興軍節度副使，<六>民推覺領州事。
units.en: On the jiazi day, Zhang Jue, formerly deputy military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was acclaimed by the people to take charge of the prefecture.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Zhang Jue, formerly deputy military commissioner of the Liaoxing Army, was acclaimed by the people to take charge of the prefecture.

units.zh: 遂與諸大臣耶律大石、左企弓、虞仲文、曹勇義、康公弼集蕃漢百官、諸軍及父老數萬人詣淳府。
units.en: Thereupon with the great ministers Yelü Dashi, Zuo Qigong, Yu Zhongwen, Cao Yongyi, and Kang Gongbi they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials, all armies, and elders numbering tens of thousands and went to Chun's residence.
units.literal: Thereupon with the great ministers Yelü Dashi, Zuo Qigong, Yu Zhongwen, Cao Yongyi, Kang Gongbi, they gathered Khitan and Han hundred officials, all armies, and elders numbering tens of thousands and went to Chun's residence.

units.zh: 初，詔留宰相張琳、李處溫與秦晉國王淳守燕。
units.en: Earlier an edict had left chancellors Zhang Lin and Li Chuwen with King of Qin-Jin Chun to guard Yan.
units.literal: Earlier an edict had left chancellors Zhang Lin and Li Chuwen with King of Qin-Jin Chun to guard Yan.

units.zh: 三月己酉，以討五國功，加知黃龍府事蒲延、懷化軍節度使高元紀、易州觀察使高正並千牛衛上將軍，五國節度使蕭陶蘇斡、寧江州防禦使大榮並靜江軍節度使。
units.en: On jiyou day of the third month, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.
units.literal: Third month, on jiyou day, for merit against the Five States, Huanglong Prefecture administrator Puyan, Huaihua Army military commissioner Gao Yuanji, and Yi Prefecture observation commissioner Gao Zheng were all promoted Thousand-Ox Guard upper generals; Five States military commissioner Xiao Taosuwan and Ningjiang Prefecture defense commissioner Darong were both made Jingjiang Army military commissioners.

units.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.en: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 乙薛往援賓州，南軍諸將實婁、特烈等往援咸州，並為女直所敗。
units.en: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.
units.literal: Yixue went to relieve Bin Prefecture; southern army generals Shilou, Telie, and others went to relieve Xian Prefecture; all were defeated by Jurchen.

units.zh: 十二月，咸、賓、祥三州及鐵驪、兀惹皆叛入女直。
units.en: In the twelfth month the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.
units.literal: Twelfth month, the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.

units.zh: 天祚走天德，秦晉國王耶律捏裏自立于燕，擢彥宗留守判官。
units.en: When Emperor Tianzuo fled to Tiande, Yelü Chun, the prince of Qin and Jin whose childhood name was Nieli, set himself up at Yan and appointed Yanzong assistant to the resident commissioner.
units.literal: When Emperor Tianzuo fled to Tiande, Yelü Chun, whose childhood name was Nieli and who was king of Qin and Jin, declared himself ruler at Yan and promoted Yanzong to assistant to the resident commissioner.

units.zh: 丙戌，肇復出，右皮室詳穩耶律敵魯擒肇及副將李立，追殺數十里，獲所棄糧餉、鎧仗。
units.en: On bingxu day Kang Zhao sallied forth again; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured him and vice general Li Li, pursued the enemy for several tens of li, and seized abandoned provisions, armor, and weapons.
units.literal: On bingxu day, Zhao again came out; Right Pishi xiangwen Yelü Dilu captured Zhao and vice general Li Li, pursued and killed for several tens of li, captured abandoned grain supplies and armor and weapons.

units.zh: 二十八年春正月辛亥朔，不受賀。
units.en: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, on the xinhai new moon of the first spring month the court declined congratulatory rites.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinhai new moon, did not accept congratulations.

units.zh: 兀納上書曰：「自蕭海裏亡入女直，彼有輕朝廷心，宜益兵以備不虞。」
units.en: Wuna wrote: "Since Xiao Haili defected to the Jurchen, they have begun to hold the court in contempt. We should reinforce the frontier before trouble arrives."
units.literal: Wuna submitted a memorial, saying, "Since Xiao Haili fled into the Jurchen, they hold the court in contempt; troops should be increased to guard against the unexpected."

units.zh: 蕭兀納耶律儼劉伸耶律胡呂
units.en: Xiao Wuna, Yelu Yan, Liu Shen, and Yelu Hulu
units.literal: Xiao Wuna, Yelu Yan, Liu Shen, Yelu Hulu

units.zh: ○肅祖昭烈皇后蕭氏懿祖莊敬皇后蕭氏玄祖簡獻皇后蕭氏德祖宣簡皇后蕭氏太祖淳欽皇后述律氏太宗靖安皇后蕭氏世宗懷節皇后蕭氏世宗妃甄氏穆宗皇后蕭氏景宗睿智皇后蕭氏聖宗仁德皇后蕭氏聖宗欽哀皇后蕭氏興宗仁懿皇后蕭氏興宗貴妃蕭氏道宗宣懿皇后蕭氏道宗惠妃蕭氏天祚皇后蕭氏天祚德妃蕭氏天祚文妃蕭氏天祚元妃蕭氏
units.en: ○ This chapter treats: Empress Zhaolie (Xiao), wife of Ancestor Su; Empress Zhuangjing (Xiao), wife of Ancestor Yi; Empress Jianxian (Xiao), wife of Ancestor Xuan; Empress Xuanjian (Xiao), wife of Ancestor De; Empress Chunqin (Shulü), wife of Taizu; Empress Jing'an (Xiao), wife of Taizong; Empress Huaijie (Xiao), wife of Shizong; Consort Zhen of Shizong; the Muzong empress (Xiao); Empress Ruizhi (Xiao), wife of Jingzong; Empress Rendé (Xiao), wife of Shengzong; Empress Qin'ai (Xiao), wife of Shengzong; Empress Renyi (Xiao), wife of Xingzong; Xingzong's imperial consort (Xiao); Empress Xuanyi (Xiao), wife of Daozong; Daozong's Consort Hui (Xiao); the Tianzuo empress (Xiao); Tianzuo's Virtuous Consort, Literary Consort, and Primary Consort (all Xiao).
units.literal: ○ Empress Zhaolie of the Xiao clan, consort of Ancestor Su; Empress Zhuangjing of the Xiao clan, consort of Ancestor Yi; Empress Jianxian of the Xiao clan, consort of Ancestor Xuan; Empress Xuanjian of the Xiao clan, consort of Ancestor De; Empress Chunqin of the Shulü clan, consort of Taizu; Empress Jing'an of the Xiao clan, consort of Taizong; Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan, consort of Shizong; Consort Zhen of Shizong; Empress of the Xiao clan, consort of Muzong; Empress Ruizhi of the Xiao clan, consort of Jingzong; Empress Rendé of the Xiao clan, consort of Shengzong; Empress Qin'ai of the Xiao clan, consort of Shengzong; Empress Renyi of the Xiao clan, consort of Xingzong; Imperial Consort of the Xiao clan, consort of Xingzong; Empress Xuanyi of the Xiao clan, consort of Daozong; Imperial Consort Hui of the Xiao clan, consort of Daozong; Empress of the Xiao clan, consort of Tianzuo; Virtuous Consort of the Xiao clan, consort of Tianzuo; Literary Consort of the Xiao clan, consort of Tianzuo; Primary Consort of the Xiao clan, consort of Tianzuo.

units.zh: 世宗懷節皇后蕭氏，小字撒葛只，淳欽皇后弟阿古只之女。
units.en: Empress Huaijie (Xiao), wife of Shizong, childhood name Sagezhi, daughter of Aguzhi, younger brother of Empress Chunqin.
units.literal: Empress Huaijie of the Xiao clan, consort of Shizong, childhood name Sagezhi, daughter of Empress Chunqin's younger brother Aguzhi.

units.zh: 重熙二十一年，更今謚。
units.en: In Chongxi 21 her current posthumous title was adopted.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, her present posthumous title was granted.

units.zh: 謚曰孝烈皇后。
units.en: Her posthumous title was Filial and Martyr Empress.
units.literal: Posthumous title: Empress Xiaolie.

units.zh: 帝為永康王，納之，生景宗。
units.en: While he was Prince of Yongkang he wed her; she bore Jingzong.
units.literal: When the emperor was Prince of Yongkang, he took her in marriage and she bore Jingzong.

units.zh: 明年秋，生萌古公主。
units.en: The following autumn she bore Princess Menggu.
units.literal: The next autumn she bore Princess Menggu.

units.zh: 天祿末，立為皇后。
units.en: Late in Tianlu she was made empress.
units.literal: At the end of Tianlu, she was established as empress.

units.zh: 在蓐，察割作亂，弒太后及帝。
units.en: Still in her lying-in, Chage rose in revolt and murdered the dowager and the emperor.
units.literal: While she was in childbed, Chage rebelled and assassinated the empress dowager and the emperor.

units.zh: 明日遇害。
units.en: The next day she too was slain.
units.literal: The next day she was killed.

units.zh: 景宗立，葬二后於醫巫閭山，建廟陵寢側。
units.en: When Jingzong succeeded, he buried both empresses on Mount Yiwulü and raised shrines beside the royal tombs.
units.literal: When Jingzong took the throne, he buried the two empresses at Mount Yiwulü and built temples beside the mausoleum.
